name: Ryanair Holdings plc

ads_ratio.source: Ryanair Holdings plc Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025 (SEC filing, accession 0001558370-25-007966), Item 12 (Description of Securities Other than Equity Securities): during FY25 the Board approved a change to the ADS ratio so that one ADS is now equal to two Ordinary Shares, a 2:1 ratio (previously 5:1); the ratio change was effected in September 2024
ads_ratio.reason: EDGAR diluted share counts are in ordinary shares while the Nasdaq price ($51.33) is per ADS; per-share figures must be scaled x2 ordinary shares per ADS to be comparable to the ADS price. Using the pre-September-2024 5:1 ratio would overstate per-ADS owner's earnings 2.5x.

fx_conversion.source: frankfurter.app — ECB reference rates (closest business day to each period end)

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 18 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency EUR converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion
USD_TRANSLATIONS_USED: the issuer files its own USD convenience translations alongside its reporting currency; the engine used the filed USD figures

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x2.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Ryanair Holdings plc Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2025 (SEC filing, accession 0001558370-25-007966), Item 12 (Description of Securities Other than Equity Securities): during FY25 the Board approved a change to the ADS ratio so that one ADS is now equal to two Ordinary Shares, a 2:1 ratio (previously 5:1); the ratio change was effected in September 2024) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.8x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
